text.en: 1. These Rules are the Parking Places (Parking of Heavy Vehicles — Lodgement) Rules 2026 and come into operation on 15 September 2026.
3. These Rules do not apply to a trailer, container trailer, low loader or flat‑bed trailer, the maximum laden weight of which exceeds 5,000 kilograms.

4. An eligible parking place is —
(a)a private parking place that —
(i)is not licensed for the parking of one or more heavy vehicles under the Parking Places (Licensing and Control of Private Parking Places for Heavy Vehicles) Rules (R 1); and
(ii)is not used in connection with any private dwelling‑house; or
(b)a private parking place that is located within a school organised and conducted directly by the Government.

heading.en: Parking of heavy vehicles in eligible parking place

text.en:
5.—(1) A person must not park a heavy vehicle at an eligible parking place during the specified period unless the parking is in accordance with the requirements mentioned in rule 6.
(2) In this rule, “specified period” means the hours between midnight and 6 a.m. of any day.

heading.en: Requirements for parking heavy vehicles in eligible parking place
How to make lodgement for parking in eligible parking place

text.en: 9. A person must not, in providing any information or document required under rule 7(2), provide any information or document that the person knows to be false or misleading in a material particular.
